adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group.findMembers`, each AJAX response unconditionally calls `self.setProperties({ user_count: result.meta.total, limit: result.meta.limit, offset: result.meta.offset, members: ... })`. The admin controller actions `next`/`previous` update `group.offset` and then immediately call `group.findMembers()` again. With rapid paging clicks, multiple `/groups/:name/members.json` requests can be in flight; because there is no cancellation or request sequencing, an earlier request can resolve after a later one and overwrite `members` and `offset` with stale `result.meta.offset`, rendering the wrong page and resetting the offset backward.
